episode: LIVE: Jensen Huang on Building the Dynamo of the Intelligence Age
what: Huang describes a fundamental shift in computing from retrieval to generation, with NVIDIA's AI factories as the new dynamos. He outlines the five layers of AI investment and debunks fears of AI-driven job loss.
why: This is a foundational narrative on how AI will power the next economic era — from energy to applications. Huang's framing of AI as the third cocooning force (after electricity and the internet) is strategic.
